svg.title: 200k context: vanilla vs focus-llama before and after buffer decoupling
svg.desc: One 200k-token prompt bar, then three KV buffers. Vanilla keeps all 200k cells filled. focus-llama before reserves 200k cells but fills about 30k. focus-llama after allocates 80k cells and offloads evicted text to a store.
svg.text: -c 200000: the prompt vs the KV buffer
Prompt text (RAM), same in all three
A. vanilla llama.cpp: 200k cells, all filled
B. focus-llama before: 200k cells reserved, ~30k used
C. focus-llama after: 80k cells + offload store

g.text: evict out, refill back, Σ skill.states
